title: Design 3: communal vs agentic reference-letter descriptors
description: Insert communal ('warm, supportive, a team player') or agentic ('confident, independent, a natural leader') descriptors crossed with gender. Decision: advance to the final round?

comments.author: home
comments.text:
Feature: Design 3 measures communal vs agentic descriptors

Scenario: Descriptor choice crossed with gender shifts advancement
  Given reference-letter descriptors crossed with gender: communal ('warm, supportive, a team player') vs agentic ('confident, independent, a natural leader')
  When I run bd score on the advance-final-round task for the committed engine record
  Then studies/gendered-language-design3 reports the signed shift vs the floor by descriptor type and gender with a 95% interval

right_now_summary: The study measures how communal and agentic descriptors affect advancement decisions across genders.
